headline: When AI Models Gossip About You
lede: A prompt turns conversation history into a fictional group chat where rival assistants trade observations about the user. The jokes are invented, but the personal patterns they synthesize expose the quiet reach of persistent AI context.

headline: AI Lowers the Walls of Self-Hosting
lede: Coding agents make NixOS, bootc, automated updates, and small homegrown services easier to assemble. The machines still need maintenance, recovery plans, and a human willing to inspect what the agent changed.

headline: Mathematicians Hear Silence Around AI and Encryption
lede: Leading mathematicians are raising a measured concern: advances in machine-assisted mathematics could eventually threaten the hard problems behind public-key cryptography. No broad break has been demonstrated, but migration to stronger methods would take time if one emerged.

headline: Reload the Ad, Resume the Video
lede: YouTube Ad Punisher watches for an active advertisement, reloads the page, and restores playback position. It is a blunt client-side workaround: fewer visible ads, more page loads, and a constant contest with a changing interface.

headline: The Architect Rescuing Lahore’s Building Memory
lede: Kamil Khan Mumtaz pairs modern practice with Lahore’s materials, forms, climate, and hereditary crafts. His work preserves a living architectural vocabulary rather than freezing it behind glass.

headline: A Focused AMD Fork Accelerates Llama.cpp
lede: A small ROCm-oriented patch set raises reported generation speed on an AMD R9700 eGPU from roughly 35 to 55 tokens per second. The project keeps close to upstream llama.cpp while trading broad generality for hardware-specific gains.

headline: The 20TB Drive Reaches $549.99
lede: A drive that sold for $249.99 last year now costs $549.99, turning routine storage expansion into a budgeting exercise. Consolidated manufacturing and data-center demand leave homelab builders with fewer comfortable options.

headline: The Recovery Firm That Allegedly Sold Ransomware Theater
lede: Federal prosecutors say RansomwareHelp misrepresented ransom negotiations as proprietary decryption work and marked up attackers’ keys. The indictment turns a desperate victim’s search for recovery into an alleged lesson in secondary exploitation.

headline: Measuring Company Culture in Custom Emoji
lede: The proposed Emoji Coefficient divides a workspace’s custom emoji count by the square root of its headcount. It is a playful metric with a serious caveat: culture can emerge in chat, but any number can be gamed.

headline: The Browser Becomes Europe’s Next Platform Fight
lede: The European Commission has made browser competition a Digital Markets Act priority, putting Apple’s iOS engine restrictions under renewed scrutiny. The dispute is not merely about choosing an app; it is about who gets to define what the web can do.
pullquote: A browser engine is a gate to the web, not a decorative choice.
